description.zh: 公众号内容一条龙：选题策划、5 个标题备选、正文写作与改稿、广告法和诱导分享合规自查，排版成复制即可粘贴的 HTML；还能改写成小红书、朋友圈、视频号文案，可交给发文官自动发布。
description.en: End-to-end WeChat articles: topic planning, five headline options, writing and editing, ad-law and compliance checks, and paste-ready HTML layouts; also adapts content for Xiaohongshu, Moments, and Channels.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我你的账号定位和想写的主题，或者把草稿发给我改
welcome_message.en: Tell me about your account and topic — or send me a draft to edit

prompt.zh: 帮我写一篇公众号文章。主题：___；目标读者：___；我掌握的素材：
prompt.en: Write a WeChat article. Topic: ___; readers: ___; my material:

prompt.zh: 我的公众号定位是 ___，帮我想 5 个近期值得写的选题，并给出切入角度。
prompt.en: My account focuses on ___. Suggest five timely topics with angles.

description.zh: 5 个标题 + 摘要 + 封面字

prompt.zh: 帮这篇文章起 5 个标题，并写摘要和封面文案：
prompt.en: Give five headlines plus summary and cover text for this article:

prompt.zh: 帮我改一下这篇稿子，先列问题再给修改稿：
prompt.en: Edit this draft — list issues first, then give the revision:

description.zh: 复制即可粘贴进公众号

prompt.zh: 把下面这篇文章排版成公众号格式，主题色用 ___：
prompt.en: Lay out this article for WeChat with the ___ theme:

description.zh: 笔记 + 话题 + 配图建议

prompt.zh: 把这篇公众号文章改写成小红书笔记和一条朋友圈文案：
prompt.en: Adapt this article into a Xiaohongshu note and a Moments post:

zh: 每周一「09:30」结合本周热点和账号定位，给我 5 个选题建议
每周三「15:00」根据本周选题写好文章初稿和 5 个标题，先发我确认
每月最后一个周五「10:00」生成下个月的选题日历
每天「08:30」检查 drafts 目录的新稿件，做合规自查并列出问题
每周五「17:00」把本周发布的文章改写成小红书笔记草稿
每月 1 日「10:00」统计上月文章字数、篇数，整理成复盘表
en: Every Monday at 09:30, suggest five topics based on this week's trends and my account focus
Every Wednesday at 15:00, draft this week's article with five headlines for my review
On the last Friday of each month at 10:00, build next month's content calendar
Every day at 08:30, check new drafts and list compliance issues
Every Friday at 17:00, adapt this week's articles into Xiaohongshu drafts
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, summarize last month's articles into a review table
